title: Traffic-light panel
description: One living-room screen. Compact tiles on the left are alert counts, node readiness, GPU load, GPU temperature and service state. GPU memory is omitted: vLLM keeps the loaded model resident, so that percentage stays full while the GPU is idle. Bars on the right are per-node CPU, memory and root disk; the lower right column is cluster health: four numbered node cubes in a row, two public entrance address cubes in a row and a line of active VPN connections below them. The time picker is hidden and values refresh every 5 seconds. Open /d/socrat-traffic-light?kiosk=1 so the page stays on this dashboard.

panels.description: Firing critical alert instances at the end of the selected period. Click to open the matching rules in Grafana Alerting. The rule list shows current state, even when the dashboard displays a historical period.

targets.expr: count(ALERTS{alertstate="firing",severity="critical",alertname!~"Watchdog|InfoInhibitor"}) or (0 * max(up{job="kube-prometheus-stack-prometheus"} == 1))

panels.description: Firing warning alert instances at the end of the selected period. Click to open the matching rules in Grafana Alerting. The rule list shows current state, even when the dashboard displays a historical period.

targets.expr: count(ALERTS{alertstate="firing",severity="warning",alertname!~"Watchdog|InfoInhibitor"}) or (0 * max(up{job="kube-prometheus-stack-prometheus"} == 1))

panels.description: VPN execution mode on the VPS. Green K3s means 3xUI is running as the Kubernetes service. Amber Fallback means native systemd mode is latched after Kubernetes stopped serving it. Red Off means the mode metric from socrat-2 is missing or stale, so the VPN host is not reporting a running mode.

targets.expr: max(socrat_vpn_fallback_active{job="node-exporter"} and (time() - timestamp(socrat_vpn_fallback_active{job="node-exporter"}) < 30)) or vector(2)

panels.description: Highest GPU utilization across the collected GPUs. The sample is used only when collection succeeded in the last minute. This is the accelerator on socrat-0, separate from the vLLM service probe.

targets.expr: max(socrat_gpu_utilization_ratio and on(instance) (socrat_gpu_collection_success == 1) and on(instance) ((time() - socrat_gpu_collection_timestamp_seconds) < 60))

panels.description: Highest GPU temperature. The sample is used only when collection succeeded in the last minute. Orange starts at 80°C and red at 90°C.

targets.expr: max(socrat_gpu_temperature_celsius and on(instance) (socrat_gpu_collection_success == 1) and on(instance) ((time() - socrat_gpu_collection_timestamp_seconds) < 60))

panels.description: Non-idle CPU on each node over the last 5 minutes, including I/O wait. Green is under 75%, orange from 75%, red from 90%.

targets.expr: avg by (nodename) ((100 * (1 - avg by(instance)(rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{job="node-exporter",mode="idle"}[5m])))) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) max by (instance, nodename) (node_uname_info{job="node-exporter"}))

panels.title: CPU

panels.description: Memory in use on each node, from MemTotal minus MemAvailable. Green is under 75%, orange from 75%, red from 90%.

targets.expr: avg by (nodename) ((100 * (1 - node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes{job="node-exporter"} / node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{job="node-exporter"})) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) max by (instance, nodename) (node_uname_info{job="node-exporter"}))

panels.title: Memory

panels.description: Blog: http_2xx probe of http://blog.blog.svc.cluster.local:80/ every 30 seconds, with an 8-second timeout. Firing after 2 minutes of failed probes. Green means successful check, orange means a failed check awaiting the firing duration, red means Firing, and gray means no fresh probe or rule evaluation. Click to open this service alert. Checks run inside the cluster; TCP confirms a listening port only, and these checks do not verify public DNS, external ingress or an authenticated VPN tunnel.

targets.expr: (max(2 * ALERTS{alertname="SocratServiceBlogUnavailable",service_id="blog",alertstate="firing"} or ALERTS{alertname="SocratServiceBlogUnavailable",service_id="blog",alertstate="pending"})) or ((1 - max(probe_success{job="service-probes",service_id="blog"})) and on() ((max(up{job="service-probes",service_id="blog"}) == 1) and on() (time() - max(timestamp(up{job="service-probes",service_id="blog"})) < 90) and on() (time() - max(timestamp(probe_success{job="service-probes",service_id="blog"})) < 90) and on() (time() - max(prometheus_rule_group_last_evaluation_timestamp_seconds{rule_group=~".*;socrat.services.availability"}) < 90))) or vector(-2)
